description: How a task's goal is folded into its details (decisions.md, UI-1). The migration that drops tasks.goal applies it to every task row, and the eval suites apply it to every case's contract, so a case reads as a migrated task would. The goal is trimmed of the characters in `trimmed` at both ends. A goal that is then empty, or equal to the title trimmed the same way, adds nothing: the details stay as they were. Otherwise details that are null, or empty once trimmed, become the trimmed goal, and any other details become the trimmed goal, `separator`, then the details unchanged.
